name: mercadolibre-mcp
description: Mercado Libre Autos (automotive): me, get_listing. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_mercadolibre_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCADOLIBRE_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_mercadolibre_client_id.description: App ID of your application (developers.mercadolibre.com > My applications); sent as client_id in the token request body.

platform_mcp_mercadolibre_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCADOLIBRE_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_mercadolibre_client_secret.description: Secret Key of the same application; sent as client_secret in the token request body.

platform_mcp_mercadolibre_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCADOLIBRE_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_mercadolibre_refresh_token.description: Refresh token (TG-...) from a one-time authorization-code consent of any Mercado Libre account to your app (valid 6 months). It is SINGLE-USE: every refresh returns a new access token (6 h) and a new refresh token, and only the last one issued is accepted. The runtime keeps a rotated refresh token in memory; set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR to also save it (<dir>/mercadolibre.json, mode 0600) so it is preferred over this variable on the next start. Do not share one refresh token between this server and the ecommerce/marketplaces Mercado Libre servers.

platform_mcp_mercadolibre_env.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCADOLIBRE_ENV
platform_mcp_mercadolibre_env.description: Vendor environment (default production): sandbox = production host with test accounts or test keys. Credentials are the environment's own; see adapter.environments in the catalog entry.

platform_mcp_mercadolibre_base_url.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCADOLIBRE_BASE_URL
platform_mcp_mercadolibre_base_url.description: Optional https base URL override (a mock or a private gateway); replaces the selected environment's base_url. Never echoed in errors.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /users/me returns the authorised user {id, nickname, site_id, country_id, ...}.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: GET /items/{item_id} with a Bearer token (vehicle example MLB1045563828, category MLB1744 in 'List vehicles'): works for any site, since the id carries the site prefix (MLA…, MLB…, MLM…, MCO…). Vehicle attributes (BRAND, MODEL, VEHICLE_YEAR, KILOMETERS …), location and pictures stay in raw.attributes / raw.location / raw.pictures.
